finding: Can public play signals prevent a reader from mistaking playful actions for preferences? In N8, the mode-aware reader improves preference log loss by 0.049–2.588 nats across all sixteen play settings; eight no-play controls remain at numerical zero. All 49,152 cases, both burn-ins and complete replay verify. This is a constructed-mechanism discovery, not confirmation or evidence about human emotions.
